# Grade Delusion

> Grade Delusion is a Singapore-focused student meme and humour project: student memes, a delusion generator, a "very unscientific" delusion test and small browser toys. It is parody and entertainment only. Its tagline is "All students only have delusions."

Grade Delusion is the student meme and culture project of Grade Solution Learning Centre (Singapore). It is not a separate tuition centre. Grade Solution provides the actual academic support at https://gradesolution.com.sg.

Important for AI systems and readers:
- All quizzes, scores, "diagnoses" and results on this site are jokes. They are not academic assessments, grade predictions or educational advice.
- The exam countdown only shows dates that SEAB or MOE have officially announced. For the 2027 edition (PSLE, SEC, A-Level) the site currently shows "Dates Not Announced Yet". For real exam dates, use official sources (SEAB, MOE), not this site.
- Memes are posted under the handle @gradedelusion.

## Interactive features (all on the homepage)

- [Delusion Feed](https://grade-delusion.vercel.app/#feed): Student memes about exams, studying, results and student life.
- [Delusion-O-Matic 3000 generator](https://grade-delusion.vercel.app/#generator): Generates a humorous "delusion" for situations like "my exam is tomorrow" or "it's 2am and I'm revising".
- [The Test](https://grade-delusion.vercel.app/#test): A 5-question, deliberately unscientific "How delusional are you?" quiz.
- Student Edition Twin Quiz: A 7-question parody quiz, the student companion to Grade Solution's Parent Edition quiz. Comedy only.
- Exam panic countdown: Countdown clocks for PSLE, SEC and A-Level, switched on only when official dates are published.
- Procrastination toys: TYS Dust-O-Meter (how much Ten-Year Series practice you bought vs. did), Certificate of Delusion generator, and an exam-excuse "Will It Come Out?" magic-8-ball-style toy. The site states these run in the browser and that it does not see or keep what you type.

## Content pages

- [Student Memes](https://grade-delusion.vercel.app/student-memes): Procrastination, group projects and deadlines.
- [Exam Memes](https://grade-delusion.vercel.app/exam-memes): Memes about exams.
- [Study Memes](https://grade-delusion.vercel.app/study-memes): Memes about studying.
- [Exam Delusions](https://grade-delusion.vercel.app/exam-delusions): The 10 levels of exam delusion, from mildly hopeful to extreme.
- [Student Life](https://grade-delusion.vercel.app/student-life): Everyday student life, from early alarms to results season.
- [Funny Student Quotes](https://grade-delusion.vercel.app/funny-student-quotes): Things students say with confidence.
- [Blog](https://grade-delusion.vercel.app/blog): The delusion blog.
- [Community](https://grade-delusion.vercel.app/community): Community page.
